rv.q: Writers: Henry Lewis, Jonathan Sayer and Henry Shields Director: Matt DiCarlo As the festive season approaches, it’s time for the members of Cornley Amateur Drama Society to embark on their latest production, and this time it’s that Christmas staple A Christmas Carol . With such a well-known and well-loved piece, what could possibly go wrong?
The overall vision displays serious potential, though it is ultimately limited by its material and stagecraft.
